# Bistro Template Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib `accordion-02` (Food Menu Accordion), renamed to **bistro**.

## Section Order & Structure

1. **Header / Navbar**: Minimal brand title ("Bistro Specialties") with quick navigation links.
2. **Hero / Title Section**: "Our Specialties" heading with elegant subtitle styling.
3. **Accordion Menu Sections**:
   - Breakfast (Grilled Beef with potatoes, Avocado Toast, etc.)
   - Lunch (Gourmet Burgers, Caesar Salad, Artisan Pastas)
   - Dinner (Prime Steaks, Grilled Salmon, Truffle Risotto)
   - Drink (Artisan Cocktails, Fresh Juices, Iced Teas)
   - Wine (Red, White, and Sparkling selections)
4. **Footer**: Copyright and required `https://www.componentdock.com/` attribution link ("Component Dock").

## Fidelity Notes

- Use Poppins font loaded via Google Fonts.
- Maintain smooth accordion toggle behavior with clean Lucide icons (`ChevronDown`, `ChevronUp`).
- Use Picsum photos (`https://picsum.photos/seed/bistro-<item>/300/300`) for menu dish thumbnails if included.
